patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and Lemlist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Gong and Lemlist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Gong only if your buying job matches “Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal” rather than Lemlist's shape. Choose Lemlist only if your buying job matches “Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $87/user/mo ” rather than Gong's shape. Workflow advantage: Gong leans lead-management; Lemlist leans prospecting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and Lemlist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Gong is Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal only (no public dollar list).; Lemlist is Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $87/user/mo yearly; Enterprise custom; 14-day trial..
- Company-size focus: Gong (mid-market, enterprise) vs Lemlist (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gong-leaning lead-management vs Lemlist-leaning prospecting.
- Researched limits: Gong — Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Lemlist — Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer.

Limitations — Gong: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core; Lemlist: Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer; Lead database included but secondary to multichannel sending.

Poor-fit cases: Gong is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases · Lemlist is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer · Avoid Gong if you actually need Lemlist's motion (Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $8)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
